What does Acetic Acid smell like?

Sharp, pungent, sour vinegar note. A trace acidic modifier best used at 1 percent or 10 percent dilution.

freshdiffusive

Use Acetic Acid in a formula

How do you use Acetic Acid in a perfume?

Read from this material's catalog record and PerfuMate's published formulas.

  • It is a top note: it shapes the opening of a perfume, the first minutes to hours, and fades before the heart and base do. On a blotter it lasts about 10 hours.
  • Its impact is 6 of 10: medium. Trial it at a modest share first and raise it on the strip rather than by guess.
  • Weigh it neat, or from a 10% dilution when you need small amounts; both are common on the bench. The free dilution calculator does the arithmetic.
